ImageDescription.value: The Kadlekai Parishe is an annual groundnut festival at Basavanagudi, Bengaluru. Groundnut is offered at the bull temple and vendors set up a temporary market (lasting about 3-4 days) where they sell their harvest. The festival is an amazing spectacle, with the roads filled with groundnut vendors and groundnuts.
